decisions.statement: Every Anthropic account with a page is reached in turn.
A credential is read off the page rather than made.
An account whose access token has lapsed is passed over rather than renewed.
A token expiring at the moment being read against has lapsed.
An account whose subscription is withdrawn is passed over.
An account that was not refreshed is named with why rather than left unsaid.
An account the endpoint refuses leaves the values beside its page unchanged.
One account refused does not stop the accounts after that account.
Nothing here starts a rate-limit window.
Nothing here writes a value the commit has.

definition: what an account has spent, read upstream and written beside that account's page
